name: Sealed Venom Container
summary: The Sealed Venom Container holds venom gathered from poisonous creatures in Silithus. In Gadgetzan, an engineer seeks it for work on a device that can speak with the dead.

sections.title: Venom for Gadgetzan
sections.body: Venom from Silithus is carried in the Sealed Venom Container. The sample is meant for an engineer in Gadgetzan who studies the supernatural. He is building a device to communicate with the dead, and the venom is payment for his work.

faq.q: What is in the Sealed Venom Container?
faq.answer: The Sealed Venom Container holds venom collected from poisonous creatures in Silithus.
The container is meant for an engineer in Gadgetzan who is working on a device to speak with the dead.
Mux Manascrambler, an engineer in Gadgetzan with an interest in the supernatural, wants the venom.

faq.q: Why does the engineer need venom?
faq.answer: The venom is payment for Mux Manascrambler's work on a device that can communicate with the dead.
